channel.title: PressMix
channel.description: PressMix publishes practical guides and tips every day: money, tech, health, home, travel, food, sports and more, plus the latest news from the web.

item.title: How to Fix Lag in Online Games (PC, Console and Mobile)
item.description: Lag ruining your matches? Learn the difference between high ping and low FPS, then try these fixes for PC, console and mobile, from Ethernet to graphics.

item.title: How to Start Freelancing With No Experience: A Step-by-Step Guide
item.description: Want to work for yourself? Here is how to start freelancing step by step: choosing a service, finding first clients, setting your rates and handling the admin.

item.title: How Much Screen Time Is OK for Kids? Guidelines by Age
item.description: How much screen time should kids have? See the main recommendations by age, why content quality matters and practical rules for healthy screen habits at home.

item.title: How to Check Tire Pressure (and What the Right Pressure Is)
item.description: Learn how to check tire pressure in five minutes, where to find the right pressure for your car and why it matters for safety, fuel use and tire life.

item.title: How to Answer "Tell Me About Yourself" in a Job Interview
item.description: Tell me about yourself" opens most job interviews. Here is a simple present, past, future structure, tips for every profile and the mistakes to avoid.

item.title: How to Store Fresh Herbs So They Last Longer
item.description: Basil, parsley, coriander, rosemary: here is how to store fresh herbs so they last longer, in a glass of water or a damp paper towel, plus how to freeze them.

item.title: How to Start Running as a Beginner (Without Getting Injured)
item.description: Want to start running but not sure where to begin? Here is a simple walk-run plan for beginners, the right pace, gear basics and tips to avoid getting injured.

item.title: What to Pack in a Carry-On Bag: The Complete Checklist
item.description: Traveling with hand luggage only? Here is what to pack in a carry-on bag, the liquid rules to know, what is banned and smart packing tips to fit everything in.

item.title: How to Descale a Kettle Naturally (Vinegar, Lemon, Citric Acid)
item.description: White crust in your kettle? Here is how to descale a kettle with vinegar, lemon or citric acid, step by step, how often to do it and how to slow limescale down.

item.title: How to Fall Asleep Faster: 10 Tips That Actually Help
item.description: Lying awake for ages? Here is how to fall asleep faster with simple habits: a regular schedule, a cool dark bedroom, fewer screens and easy breathing tricks.

item.title: How to Build an Emergency Fund (Even on a Small Income)
item.description: How much should you keep in an emergency fund, where should you put it and how can you build it on a tight budget? A simple step-by-step plan to stay protected.

item.title: How Much Water Should You Drink a Day? What the Guidelines Say
item.description: Is the 8 glasses a day rule true? See how much water you should drink a day according to health authorities, what changes your needs and signs you drink enough.

item.title: How to Make a Monthly Budget (Simple Step-by-Step Method)
item.description: Making a monthly budget takes less than an hour. Here is a simple 5-step method, the 50/30/20 rule and the mistakes to avoid so you finally take control of your money.

item.title: Why Is My Phone So Slow? 10 Fixes for Android and iPhone
item.description: Is your phone lagging? Find out why it slows down and try these 10 free fixes for Android and iPhone, from a simple restart to clearing storage or a reset.

item.title: How Long Do Eggs Last? Raw, Hard-Boiled, in the Fridge or Not
item.description: Raw or hard-boiled, in the fridge or not: here is how long eggs last, how to read the date on the carton and the float test to check if they are still good.
